Description: Squatm3 is a python tool designed to enumerate available domains generated modifying the original domain name through different techniques: Substitution attacks Flipping attack Homoglyph attack Squatm3 will help penetration testers to identify domains to be used in phishing attack simulations and security analysts to prevent effective phishing attacks.
